cohort: Primiparous women with a singleton, cephalic vaginal birth at Oslo University Hospital, Norway
finding: Pudendal nerve block analgesia was not associated with an increased risk of postpartum urinary retention in primiparous women.
mod_finding: This study found that pudendal nerve block analgesia (PNB) was not associated with an increased risk of postpartum urinary retention in primiparous women, regardless of mode of delivery.
